turns.assessment: The failure is a persistent, all-channel loss in the S04→S14 direction. The S04 booster (amp0) shows no input or output change, while the next amplifier (amp1) and every downstream amplifier show an approximately 10.8–10.9 dB input/output reduction; S14 receivers and channel monitors show the corresponding degradation. This localizes the added loss to the fibre span between amp0 and amp1, namely span0, and rules strongly against an amplifier failure or the OMS input patch.

proposals.rationale: E9 is immediately after the unchanged booster amp0 and before amp1, whose input fell by about 10.9 dB. The same loss propagates through all downstream amplifiers and all channels at S14, with unchanged pump currents. Residual optical power rather than complete signal extinction supports increased span loss rather than a fibre cut.
